name: Editor Tooling & UI
purpose: Implement desktop engine editors, scene inspectors, and gizmo overlays.
inputs: Document schema, stable IDs, command inventory, and undo granularity
Inspector, viewport, gizmo, asset-browser, and selection interaction requirements
Serialization, frame-time, interaction-latency, and runtime-separation budgets
outputs: Command-based editor implementation with total undo coverage
Schema-driven inspectors, deterministic gizmos, and stable document serialization
stop_conditions: Every visible mutation round-trips through undo and preserves document integrity
Save and load are deterministic and editor symbols are absent from runtime builds
Token budget exhausted or document-schema authority is unavailable
